errors.text: The predicted conductivity change has the wrong sign: the target reports an approximately 12% increase with SRO, whereas the hypothesis predicts a greater than 20% decrease.

The proposed mechanism is opposite to the target mechanism. The target attributes the increase to reduced lattice distortion and connected high-conductivity ordered pathways, not a percolating network of enhanced phonon scattering.

The cited evidence does not establish that percolating SRO lowers lattice thermal conductivity in a bcc refractory alloy; the carbide and dislocation studies provide only indirect support for vibrational sensitivity or SRO existence.
The baseline is framed mainly as analytical scattering and mixing models rather than the required random bcc alloy state with high lattice distortion and no connected SRO clusters.
